title: Retention Clockwork: automated evidence collector + timebound residency switches for VPC/private nodes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Implement an automated 'Retention Clockwork' subsystem that enforces configured retention tiers on private/VPC nodes and collects tamper-evident evidence bundles when residency or retention SLOs are changed or when a timebound regional switchover is initiated. Scope: (1) retention policy enforcement hooks at the local node agent, (2) evidence collector that snapshots retention config + signed attestations and KV-cache metadata, (3) deployment-time guardrails to prevent accidental global failover of private nodes, and (4) a reporting pipeline that emits compact, verifiable evidence bundles to customer-specified storage (S3-compatible endpoints) and to the Redwood audit service. Acceptance criteria: - Policy changes are enforced on node within 30s and logged to local immutable ledger. - Evidence bundle contains config diff, node attestation, KMS signature, and retention snapshot; bundle verifiably reconstructable via documented verifier. - Regional switchover requires a two-step confirmation when any node is flagged as private or under retention-hold. - Automated test harness for simulated partial-network partitions with assertions on evidence delivery. Design decisions and trade-offs: - We evaluated pushing evidence export to the control plane vs. local agent export. Chosen: local export with signed bundles (better for air-gapped/on-prem compliance and lowers TCB). Tradeoff: more complexity in agent; requires KMS/HSM integration on customer side or Redwood-managed signing when permitted. - Retention enforcement has two modes: hard-delete and tombstone-with-grace. Default to tombstone-with-grace for safety; customers can opt-in to hard-delete after explicit approval. - Use a compact JSONL + detached binary manifest format to keep bundles small while preserving cryptographic integrity. Implementation plan: 1) Node agent: add retention hook and evidence bundler (Marco) 2) Signing adapter: KMS/HSM plugin interface + Redwood default signer (Aisha/infra) 3) Control plane API: retention policy editor + switchover guard UI (PM reviews) 4) Reporting: sink adapters for S3, GCS, and customer SFTP 5) E2E tests + chaos scenarios + docs. Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout to Dedicated then Private pilot customers; unlock for general availability after 90-day pilot and security review. Metrics: evidence bundle success rate >= 99.5%, retention policy enforcement latency < 30s, false-positive switchover blocks < 0.1%. Links and artifacts: - PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4621 (agent changes) - Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/RES/Retention+Clockwork+Design - Verifier spec: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-retention-verifier - Security review ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-205 - Dashboard prototype: https://grafana.redwood-internal/r/retention-clockwork - Customer pilot checklist: https://docs.redwood.com/private/pilot-checklist Comments/notes: include operational runbook stub and dataflow diagram in design doc.
comments: 2025-02-21 - Kickoff: scoped initial agent hooks and evidence bundle schema. Assigned agent work to Marco and KMS adapter to Aisha.
2025-02-26 - Security: initial threat model complete. Security requested explicit key custody options and documented verifier before pilot. (SEC-205)

2025-03-01 - Design review: PM requested an additional UX confirmation step for switchover when >1 private node impacted; accepted with two-button confirmation in Console and optional CLI --force for emergency ops.
2025-03-04 - Engineering: PoC of local bundler completed. Bundles are ~2.8KB on average for 5-node snapshot. Performance impact on agent ~1.8% CPU at peak.
2025-03-06 - QA: began chaos tests simulating 10s network partitions and verifying bundle persistence to local disk and retry logic for remote sinks.
2025-03-07 - Blocker identified: some on-prem customers use air-gapped HSMs that require offline signing workflows. Added subtask to support offline attestation handoff.
